guarantees.claim: On uart_fifo_rxilvl equals RxFifoDepthW-1, rx_thresh_val is assigned RxFifoDepthW'(RxFifoDepth - 2).
When uart_fifo_rxilvl is not RxFifoDepthW-1 and greater than RxFifoDepthW-1, rx_thresh_val is set to all-ones ({RxFifoDepthW{1'b1}}).
For all other values (uart_fifo_rxilvl < RxFifoDepthW-1), rx_thresh_val is assigned 1'b1 << uart_fifo_rxilvl.
event_rx_watermark is always the comparison (rx_fifo_depth >= rx_thresh_val).
The default case item catches all uart_fifo_rxilvl values not equal to RxFifoDepthW-1, and the internal if-else further selects between > and <= subranges.

assumptions.claim: Parameter RxFifoDepth must be at least 2; otherwise the expression RxFifoDepth - 2 in line 347 can produce a non-sensical negative/underflowed threshold.
assumptions.risk: rx_thresh_val becomes a large unsigned value, potentially permanently falsifying (or asserting) the watermark event, breaking FIFO flow control or interrupt generation.

uncertain_points.claim: The threshold value for uart_fifo_rxilvl == RxFifoDepthW-1 is set to RxFifoDepth - 2 instead of a direct power-of-two or fill-level-dependent expression. The design intent (e.g., prevent FIFO full, leave room for remaining entries) is unclear.
uncertain_points.risk: If this value is inappropriate for the watermark interrupt, the system may assert the event at an unexpected fill level, leading to overflow or underutilization of the RX FIFO.
